head: codex/5757-observatory-corrective
title: [v0.91.8][observatory][security] Fix trusted-origin, rerender race, and shared-certificate proof
body:
## Summary

- Restrict Runtime v3 Observatory browser API selection to the exact trusted `https://localhost:20997` origin before fetch, bearer login, or WSS construction.
- Add monotonic generation guards across retained fallback, live polling, WSS messages, and stop/connect transitions so stale completions cannot overwrite newer operator intent.
- Extend the integrated Observatory proof with trusted-origin negative cases, stale completion races, authenticated WSS control, and shared localhost certificate proof across ports 8765 and 20997.

## Validation

- `csdlc-validate finalize --request .csdlc/requests/5757-finalize.json`
- `bash adl/tools/test_v0917_html_observatory_integrated_proof.sh`
- `node --check demos/html-observatory/app.js`
- `git diff --check`
- `csdlc-review guard --request .csdlc/requests/5757-review-guard.json`

Closes #5757
Closes #5722
